recipes.name: Red peas soup
steps: Soak kidney beans overnight, drain and boil vigorously in fresh water for at least 10 minutes.
Simmer beans until completely tender, adding water when needed.
Add pumpkin, yam, carrot, onion and thyme and simmer until almost tender.
Mix flour with water into spinners and simmer in the soup 15–20 minutes until cooked.

recipes.name: Mannish water
ingredients: 1 kg cleaned goat meat with bones
steps: Rinse goat meat and place in a large pot with water.
Bring to a boil, skim foam, and simmer until meat is tender, approximately 2 hours.
Add peeled and chopped provisions, vegetables and aromatics.
Simmer until provisions are soft; remove bones and season before serving.

recipes.name: Fish tea
steps: Simmer cleaned fish in water for 15–20 minutes until it flakes.
Lift fish out and strain broth carefully to remove bones.
Add finely diced pumpkin, carrot, onion, scallion and thyme to broth and cook until tender.
Return deboned fish flakes, heat through and season; check again for small bones.

recipes.name: Saturday soup
steps: Cover chicken with water in a soup pot and simmer 20 minutes.
Add pumpkin, peeled yam, carrot, onion and scallion.
Mix flour with enough water to form a firm dough and roll small spinners.
Add spinners, simmer until chicken is cooked and vegetables tender; poultry must reach 74°C/165°F.

recipes.name: Pepperpot soup
steps: Wash callaloo and okra thoroughly and chop them.
Simmer pumpkin, beans, onion and thyme in water for 15 minutes.
Add callaloo and okra, cover and cook until vegetables soften.
Stir, adjust consistency with water and cook until all greens are tender.

recipes.name: Cow foot stew
steps: Blanch cleaned cow feet and discard the water.
Cover with fresh water, add onion, garlic, scallion, thyme and simmer 3–4 hours or pressure-cook according to equipment instructions.
Once tender, add browning and cooked beans.
Simmer uncovered until gravy thickens; serve hot.

recipes.name: Tripe and beans
steps: Blanch cleaned tripe, discard water and slice into manageable strips.
Simmer in fresh water until tender, often 2 hours or longer.
Add onion, scallion, garlic and thyme and continue cooking to develop sauce.
Fold in cooked beans and simmer 15 minutes; serve only when tripe is fully tender.

recipes.name: Curried chickpeas
steps: Sauté onion and garlic in oil for 3 minutes.
Stir in curry powder for 20 seconds without scorching.
Add sliced carrot, chickpeas and coconut milk; simmer for 12–15 minutes.
Adjust seasoning and cook until carrot is tender, then serve with rice.

recipes.name: Ital stew
steps: Peel and dice pumpkin, banana and carrot.
Simmer these vegetables with onion, thyme, coconut milk and 200 ml water for 12 minutes.
Add cooked peas and callaloo and cook until greens soften.
Reduce slightly; season according to household preferences and serve warm.

recipes.name: Ital vegetable rundown
steps: Bring coconut milk to a gentle simmer with onion, scallion and thyme.
Cook uncovered 8–10 minutes to reduce slightly.
Add diced pumpkin and carrot; cook until almost tender.
Add shredded cabbage and simmer until tender and coconut liquid is saucy.

recipes.name: Steamed cabbage and carrots
steps: Wash and slice all vegetables into thin pieces.
Sauté onion and sweet pepper in oil for 3 minutes.
Add cabbage, carrot, scallion and water; cover and cook 8–12 minutes.
Uncover, cook off excess liquid and season to taste.

recipes.name: Ackee and callaloo
steps: Wash and chop callaloo; drain safe commercially prepared ackee.
Sauté onion, scallion, tomato and thyme in oil.
Add callaloo with a splash of water, cover and cook until tender.
Gently fold in ackee, heat through and serve without crushing the fruit.

recipes.name: Brown stew fish
steps: Pat fish dry and season lightly.
Sear fish in oil until lightly browned and cooked; remove to a plate.
Sauté onion, tomato and pepper, add thyme, browning and water.
Simmer 5 minutes, return fish and spoon sauce over until heated through.

recipes.name: Saltfish rundown
steps: Soak and simmer cod in fresh water until desalinated; remove all bones.
Simmer coconut milk, onion, tomato, scallion and thyme uncovered.
When sauce thickens after about 12–15 minutes, fold in flaked cod.
Heat through gently and serve with boiled green banana.

recipes.name: Pickled herring
steps: Read label for whether herring is ready to eat; desalt briefly if needed.
Bring vinegar, water, sliced onion, carrot and allspice to a gentle simmer.
Cool the pickle liquid completely before combining with ready-to-eat fish.
Refrigerate covered and serve cold; keep the product chilled according to its label.

recipes.name: Steamed parrotfish
steps: Check legality and sustainability of locally available parrotfish and consider alternative responsibly sourced fish.
Sauté onion, carrot and tomato briefly in a lidded skillet.
Add thyme, scallion and water; simmer 5 minutes.
Add fish, cover and steam gently until center reaches 63°C/145°F; check bones.

recipes.name: Garlic lobster
steps: Thaw lobster safely in refrigerator if frozen and pat dry.
Melt butter over gentle heat with crushed garlic, without browning it.
Cook lobster in a covered skillet or under a broiler until flesh is opaque and firm, checking for doneness.
Spoon garlic butter and lime juice over cooked lobster and serve immediately.

recipes.name: Crayfish rundown
steps: Rinse cleaned crayfish tails and refrigerate until cooking.
Simmer coconut milk with onion, scallion, tomato and thyme until slightly reduced.
Add crayfish tails and simmer gently until opaque and fully cooked.
Serve over boiled provisions; avoid overcooking shellfish.

recipes.name: Fish escovitch with bammy
steps: Fry fish in moderate oil until fully cooked and drain.
Simmer vinegar with carrot, onion and bonnet for 3–5 minutes.
Warm or pan-fry commercially prepared bammy according to package instructions.
Serve fish with warm escovitch vegetables and bammy on the side.

recipes.name: Saltfish buljol
steps: Desalt cod in simmering fresh water, repeat if needed and remove bones.
Flake cod into a mixing bowl and cool.
Dice tomato, onion, pepper and scallion; combine with cod and oil.
Dress with lime, taste for salt and serve promptly with bread or provisions.
